decision: Form as an unincorporated partnership of three trading as Apple Computer Company rather than as a corporation
state_before: A working 6502 board designed late in 1975; no entity of any kind in the record before this date
information_available: A three-page typed agreement with three signatures, catalogued with a 45/45/10 allocation and three functional duties; text unread
unknowns: Whether a corporation was considered and rejected; who drafted it; whether the style was registered; place of signing
alternatives: A corporation (formed nine months later); sole proprietorship; no paper at all
constraints: No capital, no premises of record, no filing; a general partnership carries unlimited liability, which nobody in the record writes about
actual_result: RETROSPECTIVE: no incorporation until 1977-01-03 and the partnership style dies out of the company's own print by June 1977
confidence: Medium on the event / Low on every motive

decision: Wayne withdraws and the remaining two continue against an amendment letter signed by all three
information_available: Two separately dated instruments in one lot, the interval corroborated by the lot's own dates
unknowns: The consideration; who initiated it; whether the amendment severed liability or only interest
alternatives: Staying in on a changed split; a dormant interest; refusing to sign
constraints: Whatever the amendment required of two continuing partners against a withdrawing one
actual_result: RETROSPECTIVE: the 1981 cap table lists three holders and no fourth name - an absence, not a record of termination
confidence: High on the dates / Low on everything they mean

decision: Distribute through other people's paper and place no maker advertisement of its own
state_before: Product with no printed price, address, telephone or letterhead
information_available: A New York retailer advertisement from September 1976, a Berkeley mail-order offer from November 1976, a technical article and an exhibitor list - none of them the maker's
unknowns: Whether any dealer held stock under agreement; whether the maker could advertise
alternatives: Maker advertising (used by Processor Technology, IMSAI and Sphere in the same magazine); its own mail order; franchising; the club bulletin board
constraints: No capital for advertising; no address or telephone to print until May-June 1977
rationale: UNKNOWN - a decision and a default and an incapacity are indistinguishable on this record
actual_result: RETROSPECTIVE: the maker's first self-published advertisement is June 1977, one quarter after the boundary
confidence: High on the non-use / UNKNOWN on the choice

decision: Incorporate in California as Apple Computer, Inc.
state_before: A two-man partnership trading under at least two printed name forms, selling through other people's advertisements
information_available: One registrant sentence in the FY1994 10-K and one 1981 trade clause giving the year on unrelated lineages
unknowns: Officers, purpose, authorised capital, share structure at formation, and the supersession mechanics - none documented anywhere searched
alternatives: Continuing as a partnership; forming in another state (a Utah hypothesis was tried and produced nothing)
constraints: Nothing in the record shows outside capital arriving before the date, which a capital-forced-incorporation story requires
rationale: UNKNOWN - liability and capital and tax and credibility are unranked
actual_result: RETROSPECTIVE: the corporation files no reaching EDGAR text before 1994-01-26, so its whole early record is print-only
confidence: High on the year / Medium on the day / UNKNOWN on the why
